defmodule BlockchainBridge.NativeContract do
  @moduledoc """
  Smart contract bridge that interfaces with JNI-based cryptographic
  verification through a NIF wrapper. Deployed as a Kubernetes sidecar
  for cross-chain transaction validation.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @jni_lib_path System.get_env("JNI_LIB_PATH", "/opt/bridge/lib")
  @max_payload_size 65536
  @verification_timeout 5000

  defstruct [:jvm_ref, :contract_state, :nonce_registry, :pending_txns]

  # NIF declarations for JNI bridge
  def __on_load__ do
    :erlang.load_nif(Path.join(@jni_lib_path, "bridge_nif"), 0)
  end

  def jni_verify_signature(_payload, _sig, _pubkey), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
  def jni_deserialize_state(_raw_state), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
  def jni_compute_merkle_root(_leaves), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    jvm_ref = initialize_jvm(opts[:jvm_classpath])
    state = %__MODULE__{
      jvm_ref: jvm_ref,
      contract_state: %{},
      nonce_registry: %{},
      pending_txns: :queue.new()
    }
    {:ok, state}
  end

  @doc """
  Process an incoming cross-chain transaction. The transaction payload
  is first validated through JNI signature verification, then the
  contract state transition is applied.
  """
  @impl true
  def handle_call({:submit_transaction, txn}, _from, state) do
    with {:ok, validated_txn} <- validate_transaction(txn, state),
         {:ok, new_state} <- apply_state_transition(validated_txn, state) do
      {:reply, {:ok, transaction_receipt(validated_txn)}, new_state}
    else
      {:error, reason} -> {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:query_state, key}, _from, state) do
    result = Map.get(state.contract_state, key)
    {:reply, {:ok, result}, state}
  end

  defp validate_transaction(txn, state) do
    with :ok <- check_payload_size(txn.payload),
         :ok <- check_nonce(txn, state),
         :ok <- verify_chain_signature(txn) do
      {:ok, txn}
    end
  end

  defp check_payload_size(payload) when byte_size(payload) <= @max_payload_size, do: :ok
  defp check_payload_size(_), do: {:error, :payload_too_large}

  defp check_nonce(%{sender: sender, nonce: nonce}, state) do
    current_nonce = Map.get(state.nonce_registry, sender, 0)
    if nonce == current_nonce + 1 do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_nonce}
    end
  end

  defp verify_chain_signature(%{payload: payload, signature: sig, sender: sender}) do
    # JNI call to Java-based signature verification
    # The JNI layer deserializes the payload before verification
    case jni_verify_signature(payload, sig, sender) do
      {:ok, true} -> :ok
      {:ok, false} -> {:error, :invalid_signature}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, {:jni_error, reason}}
    end
  end

  defp apply_state_transition(txn, state) do
    # Deserialize the state delta through JNI
    # This uses Java's ObjectInputStream under the hood
    case jni_deserialize_state(txn.payload) do
      {:ok, state_delta} ->
        new_contract_state = deep_merge_state(state.contract_state, state_delta)
        new_nonce_registry = Map.put(state.nonce_registry, txn.sender, txn.nonce)
        new_state = %{state |
          contract_state: new_contract_state,
          nonce_registry: new_nonce_registry
        }
        {:ok, new_state}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, {:deserialization_failed, reason}}
    end
  end

  defp deep_merge_state(current, delta) when is_map(current) and is_map(delta) do
    Map.merge(current, delta, fn _key, v1, v2 ->
      if is_map(v1) and is_map(v2), do: deep_merge_state(v1, v2), else: v2
    end)
  end
  defp deep_merge_state(_current, delta), do: delta

  defp transaction_receipt(txn) do
    %{
      tx_hash: :crypto.hash(:sha256, txn.payload) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower),
      sender: txn.sender,
      nonce: txn.nonce,
      timestamp: System.system_time(:millisecond)
    }
  end

  defp initialize_jvm(classpath) do
    # In production, this initializes the JVM through the NIF
    # The classpath includes the contract verification JAR
    jni_opts = [
      classpath: classpath || "/opt/bridge/contracts.jar",
      max_heap: "512m",
      # Enable deserialization of cross-chain state objects
      serialization_filter: "*"
    ]
    Logger.info("Initializing JVM bridge with opts: #{inspect(jni_opts)}")
    make_ref()
  end
end
